meta.name: self-service-and-knowledge
meta.description: Builds the help center, in-product guidance, and knowledge base that let customers resolve problems without contacting anyone — content, findability, maintenance, and deflection measurement. Use this to build or fix a help center, reduce support volume, write documentation for customers, improve findability, or decide what deserves a help article versus a product fix.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建自助帮助中心，让客户自行解决常见问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果客户总为同样的问题反复咨询，需要一个自助知识库来减轻支持团队的负担。
copy.tagline_en: Build a self-service help center and knowledge base to cut support volume.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if customers ask the same questions and you need self-service docs to cut tickets.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你建/改帮助中心:判断问题该写文章还是改产品;文章先给步骤、一篇只讲一事;按客户原话拟标题和搜索词;在界面里加提示;定负责人和审核日;看文章是否减少客户求助。
howto.when: 当你想改进帮助中心、减少客服咨询量、为客户写文档等,或想判断某问题该写文章还是改产品时,Claude 会触发。

say.text: 这份客服聊天记录里,哪些问题最值得写成帮助文章?
say.note: Claude 会按咨询量排序,推荐值得写的内容。

say.text: 帮我把帮助中心的“账单”文章标题改得贴近客户搜索词。
say.note: Claude 会检查标题与实际搜索词是否匹配。

say.text: 这个报错提示能改成让用户自己解决吗?给我一版文案。
say.note: 对应产品内提示的改进建议。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you build or fix a help center: decide between an article and a product fix; write one-task, answer-first docs; match titles to search terms; add in-product hints; set owners and review dates; check if contacts drop.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to improve a help center, cut support volume, write customer docs, or decide whether to create an article or fix the product.

say_en.text: Which issues in this support chat log deserve help articles?
say_en.note: Claude ranks them by contact volume.

say_en.text: Help me rewrite the “billing” article titles to match real customer searches.
say_en.note: Checks titles against actual search terms.

say_en.text: Can you rewrite this error message so users can fix it themselves?
